title: Telmisartan attenuates diabetic nephropathy by mitigating oxidative stress and inflammation, and upregulating Nrf2/HO-1 signaling in diabetic rats.
authors: Antar, Samar A; Abdo, Walied; Taha, Reda S; Farage, Amira E; El-Moselhy, Laila E; Amer, Mohamed E; Abdel Monsef, Ahmed S; Abdel Hamid, Amer M; Kamel, Emadeldin M; Ahmeda, Ahmad F; Mahmoud, Ayman M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究替米沙坦对糖尿病肾病的保护作用，涉及氧化应激和Nrf2/HO-1信号，仅含少量分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Diabetic nephropathy (DN) is a serious complication of diabetes and can lead to renal failure. Telmisartan (TEL) is an approved angiotensin II type 1 receptor blocker for the treatment of hypertension and possesses nephroprotective efficacy. The study investigated the beneficial effect of TEL on renal oxidative stress, inflammatory response, and apoptosis in type 1 diabetic rats, pointing to the possible role of Nrf2/HO-1 signaling. Diabetes was induced by streptozotocin (STZ), and TEL (5 and 10 mg/kg) was supplement for 8 weeks. TEL ameliorated hyperglycemia, prevented body weight loss and kidney hypertrophy, decreased serum creatinine and urea, and prevented histopathological alterations in diabetic rats. Malondialdehyde (MDA), nitric oxide (NO), NF-kappaB p65 and TNF-alpha were increased, whereas GSH, SOD and Bcl-2 were decreased in the kidney of diabetic rats. Treatment with TEL ameliorated oxidative stress, suppressed NF-kappaB p65 and TNF-alpha, and boosted cellular antioxidant defenses and Bcl-2. TEL upregulated Nrf2 and HO-1 in the kidney of both normal and diabetic rats. In addition, TEL downregulated VEGF and MMP-9 in the kidney of diabetic rats. In silico molecular docking simulations revealed the potent binding affinity of TEL to NF-kappaB, MMP-9, Keap1 and HO-1. In conclusion, TEL attenuates DN by ameliorating hyperglycemia, oxidative stress, inflammation, apoptosis and angiogenesis and upregulation of Nrf2/HO-1 signaling.
abstract_zh: 糖尿病肾病（DN）是糖尿病的严重并发症，可导致肾衰竭。替米沙坦（TEL）是一种已获批用于治疗高血压的血管紧张素II 1型受体阻滞剂，并具有肾脏保护功效。本研究探讨了TEL对1型糖尿病大鼠肾脏氧化应激、炎症反应和细胞凋亡的有益作用，并指出其可能涉及Nrf2/HO-1信号通路。通过链脲佐菌素（STZ）诱导糖尿病，并补充TEL（5和10 mg/kg）持续8周。TEL改善了高血糖，防止了体重减轻和肾脏肥大，降低了血清肌酐和尿素水平，并阻止了糖尿病大鼠的组织病理学改变。糖尿病大鼠肾脏中丙二醛（MDA）、一氧化氮（NO）、NF-kappaB p65和TNF-alpha升高，而GSH、SOD和Bcl-2降低。TEL治疗改善了氧化应激，抑制了NF-kappaB p65和TNF-alpha，并增强了细胞抗氧化防御和Bcl-2。TEL上调了正常和糖尿病大鼠肾脏中的Nrf2和HO-1。此外，TEL下调了糖尿病大鼠肾脏中的VEGF和MMP-9。计算机分子对接模拟显示TEL与NF-kappaB、MMP-9、Keap1和HO-1具有强结合亲和力。总之，TEL通过改善高血糖、氧化应激、炎症、细胞凋亡和血管生成以及上调Nrf2/HO-1信号通路来减轻DN。
